title: Requests for Lunez Massage During a Session Standard
summary: When a client requests Lunez massage during a session, the therapist must remain calm and professional, communicate the approved charge and procedure, and never negotiate privately or make personal arrangements.

sections.title: The Standard
paragraphs: When a client requests for lunez massage during a session, the therapist is expected to remain calm, professional, and informative. The therapist should provide the client with the necessary information about the service, including the applicable charge, so the client can make an informed decision.
The therapist should not make personal arrangements with the client or independently negotiate the price. Any additional service must follow the approved Zura Spa procedure and pricing.

sections.title: Therapist's Mindset
paragraphs: Therapists should understand that a client's request should be handled professionally and without embarrassment, judgment, excitement, or personal involvement.
The correct mindset is: "The client has made a request. My responsibility is to communicate the approved information professionally and follow Zura Spa procedure."
The therapist should maintain clear professional boundaries and ensure that the request does not affect the quality or professionalism of the ongoing session.

sections.title: What Therapists Should Do
list: Remain calm and professional when the request is made.
Explain that lunez massage is an additional service.
Explain any relevant service requirements or conditions according to Zura Spa policy.
Obtain the necessary confirmation before proceeding.
Follow the approved payment and service procedure.
Maintain professional boundaries throughout the interaction.
Refer questions outside their authority to management.

sections.title: What Therapists Should Not Do
list: Do not react with embarrassment, mockery, anger, or judgment.
Do not shame or ridicule a client for making the request.
Do not negotiate or create a personal price with the client.
Do not provide the service without following the required Zura Spa procedure.
Do not accept private payment where the Spa's approved system requires otherwise.
Do not make personal arrangements with clients outside the Spa's approved service structure.
Do not allow the request to compromise professionalism or client boundaries.

sections.title: Zura Spa Mindset
paragraphs: Inform professionally. Maintain boundaries. Follow procedure.

A client making a request does not change the therapist's responsibility to uphold Zura Spa's standards. Every additional service must be handled with clarity, professionalism, consistency, and respect.
At Zura Spa, every service has a standard and every standard must be followed.

remember: Inform professionally. Maintain boundaries. Follow procedure. Never negotiate privately or make personal arrangements.
